nf48e9422f0.summary: Yung Guan-KY (1589) breached listing rules after all three independent directors resigned and no by-election was completed in time. Its stock remains suspended and will move to a changed trading method from August 13.
nf48e9422f0.why: Taiwan Stock Exchange listing rules require listed companies to maintain sufficient independent directors, and breaches can lead to restricted trading. Governance failures can weigh on share prices and liquidity.

n508dc2896e.headline: Lombardy Is Europe's Third Regional Economy: GDP of 505 Billion, Only Île-de-France and London Are Worth More
n508dc2896e.summary: Lombardy's GDP of 505 billion makes it Europe's third-largest regional economy, behind only Île-de-France and London. Manufacturing and SMEs are strengths, while taxation, energy costs and skilled labor shortages weigh on it.
n508dc2896e.why: Lombardy, centred on Milan, is Italy's largest regional economy and a major manufacturing hub. Its cost base and labor market affect Italian industrial output and corporate profitability.

nec94313235.headline: University rents: room prices down 6.2% in a year, but living away from home remains a heavy burden, especially in some cities
nec94313235.summary: Student room prices in Italy fell 6.2% in a year, while Milan remains the most expensive city at 704 euros a month after a 3.8% decline and rents rose in Rome and Florence.
nec94313235.why: Student housing costs affect household budgets and the rental market, which matters for real estate investors and property developers in Italian cities.
